title: Aquarium Oxygen Drop During Night
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aquarium:sensor
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=0 AND hour<6
| stats min(dissolved_oxygen_mg_l) as min_dissolved_oxygen_mg_l by tank
| where min_dissolved_oxygen_mg_l<5
| sort min_dissolved_oxygen_mg_l
description: Uses Aquarium oxygen telemetry telemetry to monitor lowest nighttime dissolved oxygen levels in each tank in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for aeration problems before fish show visible distress, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Aquarium oxygen telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Tank table of minimum nighttime dissolved oxygen.
grandmaExplanation: It builds lowest nighttime dissolved oxygen levels in each tank so you can spot aeration problems before fish show visible distress before it becomes annoying.
